title: Perfect privacy
statement: A secret-sharing scheme has perfect privacy with respect to a monotone access structure if, for every unauthorized finite set of parties and every two secrets, there is a bijection of the randomness space such that each choice of randomness and its image produce identical shares for every party in that set.
hypotheses_covered: The set of parties is unauthorized
The claim holds for every pair of secrets
There exists a bijection of the randomness space
Shares agree for every randomness and every party in the set
